agent_events — global ring buffer for structured agent/session events.

Provides a pub-compatible source for the HTTP SSE gateway's /api/events endpoint. Works like the log ring but carries structured agent-level events (session start/end, tool calls, model responses, errors).

Thread-safe via a Lock. agentEventRingInit() must be called once in the daemon before any pushAgentEvent() calls (same pattern as log ringInit()).

Types

AgentEvent = object
  kind*: AgentEventKind
  userId*: string
  channel*: string
  toolName*: string          ## populated for aekToolCall / aekToolResult
  summary*: string           ## human-readable one-liner
  ts*: string                ## ISO-8601 timestamp (set by pushAgentEvent)
Source   Edit   
AgentEventKind = enum
  aekSessionStart = "session_start", aekSessionEnd = "session_end",
  aekToolCall = "tool_call", aekToolResult = "tool_result",
  aekModelResponse = "model_response", aekError = "error"
